narrative.overview: The user-selected Design C brings PUKEY's dialogue language into an editable native desktop workbench: smoky black sheets, a mint selection ribbon, pink primary actions, and off-white ornamental headings. Neutral body type keeps settings, paths, and installation state readable. The approved Qt study is the visual authority; current implementation is recorded in `manager/theme.py`, `manager/widgets.py`, and `manager/gui.py`.
keyCharacteristics: Horizontal mod navigation above textured dialogue sheets.
Independently scrolling settings and editable keybindings, sharing one save action.
Persistent image and video actions, explicit installation state, and visible keyboard focus.
Native PySide6/Qt Widgets for Windows and Linux; English interface copy.
GitHub Pages web surface: authored SVG smoke, grain, mint ribbon and pink stroke; no game artwork.

rules.name: Visible State
rules.body: Pair color with explicit text, selection, focus, or control state.

rules.name: Persistent Action
rules.body: Keep saving, image preview/apply/restore, and video import/restore accessible outside scrolling content. Show the actions appropriate to the active capability and actual state.

rules.name: One Pink Stroke
rules.body: Each page shows at most one pink primary action; every other action is a dark secondary button.

rules.name: Reading Face
rules.body: Amarante and Oswald never set paragraphs, list items or table cells; long text stays in the system sans.

dos: **Do** reuse the native Qt tokens, textured sheets, mint navigation, and Amarante/Oswald hierarchy.
**Do** preserve explicit state, labelled editable controls, visible focus, and persistent actions at checked desktop sizes.
**Do** retain extraction metadata in `manager/assets/game-ui-layout.json` and font licenses in `manager/assets/fonts/`.
**Do** build web surfaces from `assets/site.css` tokens, the authored SVG materials and the self-hosted font subsets; keep the OFL texts beside the fonts.
**Do** keep long web reading in the system sans on dimmed sheets with soft dialogue text.
donts: **Don't** describe HTML replicas, iOS controls, or web breakpoints as implemented native UI.
**Don't** infer Linux runtime or gameplay compatibility from visual and offscreen checks.
**Don't** ship original game artwork. Read it only from a present supported installation; a local cache alone must not enable it.
**Don't** put game artwork, extracted textures or screenshots containing them on the web site; web materials are authored SVGs only.
**Don't** use the mint ribbon as a decorative section label; it marks selection or real state.
